final: WITH race_groups AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM race_groups) SELECT AVG(g.avg_points), AVG(g.record_count), AVG(g.record_count - o.avg_count) FROM race_groups AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND g.record_count > o.avg_count
